headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.summary: 中信证券研报表示，基本面视角，预计二季度银行息差表现良好、资本市场和财富业务驱动中收增长，在此背景下银行营收增速保持稳定良好态势，盈利增速或将小幅上行。投资视角看，上周银行板块延续7月以来的积极趋势，但受市场风格影响周内指数大幅波动。中信证券预计，未来两周A股波动率仍将保持偏高水平，银行板块相对收益或将走弱；但经营格局稳定和宏观叙事等长逻辑仍在继续演绎，全年绝对收益空间仍将延续。

headlines.title_en: CITIC Securities: Banks' annual absolute return potential to persist
headlines.summary_en: CITIC Securities research report says, from a fundamentals perspective, bank net interest margins are expected to perform well in Q2, with capital market and wealth businesses driving fee income growth. In this context, banks' revenue growth maintains a stable and sound trend, and profit growth may rise slightly. From an investment perspective, the banking sector continued its positive trend since July last week, but index volatility was significant during the week due to market style. CITIC Securities expects A-share volatility to remain at a relatively high level over the next two weeks, and the banking sector's relative returns may weaken; however, long-term drivers such as stable operating conditions and macro narratives continue to unfold, and full-year absolute return potential remains intact.

headlines.title_en: [Market Liquidity Indicator] Market rates fall below policy rate
headlines.summary_en:
On August 3, the DR007 closed down for a third consecutive session to 1.4204%, and further fell below the key rate level of 1.4% to 1.3836% in early trading today. After several days of liquidity injections, the central bank achieved a net drain of 559 billion yuan today.
--------
Note: Short-term money market rates such as DR007 reflect the abundance of market funds. Besides lending rates for the real economy, many transactions in financial markets like stocks and bonds rely on 'borrowing' to leverage; loan costs depend on short-term funding rates. DR007 is typically regarded as China's short-end rate anchor. The gap between DR007 and the central bank's 7-day reverse repo rate (policy rate) shows whether the market is short on cash. headlines.title: 港股异动丨7月车企交付出炉，汽车股再度下跌，多股连跌3日
headlines.summary: 港股汽车股继续跌势，赛力斯跌6%，小鹏集团、岚图汽车跌4.3%，理想汽车跌4%，奇瑞汽车跌3.6%，吉利汽车、广汽集团跌近3%，长城汽车、零跑汽车跌2.5%，北京汽车、蔚来汽车、比亚迪股份跌超1%以上。此外，赛力斯、理想汽车、吉利汽车等多股录得3连跌行情。 消息面上，7月新能源车企交付数据呈现出强者恒强、分化加剧的格局，部分车企增速放缓、同环比双降，叠加盈利预警冲击，引发板块集体低迷。 内需严重不足，2026年上半年国内汽车销量累计同比下降21.1%，终端消费动力疲软。此外，市场担忧2027年新能源免征购置税政策结束后需求提前透支，可能带来四季度“抢装”

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong stocks move: July carmaker deliveries out, auto stocks fall again, several down for 3 consecutive days
headlines.summary_en: Hong Kong auto stocks continued their decline, with Seres down 6%, Xpeng Group and Voyah Auto down 4.3%, Li Auto down 4%, Chery Auto down 3.6%, Geely Auto and GAC Group down nearly 3%, Great Wall Motor and Leapmotor down 2.5%, and BAIC Motor, NIO, and BYD down over 1%. Additionally, Seres, Li Auto, Geely Auto, and several others recorded three consecutive sessions of declines. On the news front, July NEV maker delivery data showed a pattern of the strong getting stronger and widening divergence, with some automakers seeing slowing growth and declines in both year-on-year and month-on-month terms, compounded by profit warning shocks, dragging the sector lower. Domestic demand is severely insufficient, with domestic auto sales cumulative volume down 21.1% year-on-year in H1 2026, reflecting weak end-consumer momentum.
